skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of accounting information systems, the role of accountants in these systems, and the development cycle of accounting information systems.
Apply knowledge to organize accounting documents, accounts, and ledgers.
Organize and manage databases in a business context.
Describe accounting information systems using various tools and evaluate the differences between these tools.
Develop critical thinking skills to improve processes and apply accounting methods and policies in organizations.
Utilize basic computer skills in the use of Microsoft Office products for organizing, designing, and presenting accounting information systems.
Understand and apply enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems in business contexts.
Organize planning, coordination, and management of resources, evaluate, and improve the efficiency of activities.
